ios.desc:
VANT is your shopping companion in your pocket. Find what you're looking for, get honest style advice, and shop from 1,600+ brands, all in one place.

FREE TO DOWNLOAD. FREE TO USE.
Mall, The Edit, Wardrobe and Style Chat are free, plus 5 Lens scans every month. VANT Pro adds unlimited Lens scans and hears your concierge's replies spoken aloud.

STYLE CONCIERGE
Not sure what to wear, or what to get someone? Ask. Chat with your personal style advisor for outfit ideas, gift ideas, brand recommendations and honest feedback, any time.

SHOP WITH YOUR CAMERA
Spot a piece you love? Point your camera at it to identify it, find similar pieces, and shop directly from the brands you love.

DISCOVER YOUR MALL
Browse and save your favorite brands, from global icons to emerging designers, across apparel, accessories, jewelry, watches, home and tech.

THE EDIT
Stay inspired with a curated editorial feed of style stories, trends, and looks from the world's best brands.

WARDROBE
Save every piece from the lens or any website in one place, so nothing you fall for gets lost in a screenshot folder.

Your style. Your mall. Your personal fashion concierge VANT.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
Free to use, PRO version unlocks PRO features.
VANT Monthly: $9.99/month, auto-renewing
VANT Yearly: $79.99/year, auto-renewing
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Account Settings on the App Store. Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
